name: pptx-runtime
author: octos
description: Rust-native PPTX authoring, direct PNG rendering and review evidence using DeckCraft

tools.name: pptx_tool
tools.description: Build/edit editable PPTX, render PNG, inspect layout, enforce native QA gates, propose text fit, localize text with OCR (macOS), compare/crop images and record review evidence. No Python, Node or LibreOffice. Read the pptx skill for schemas; action=help lists operations. Outputs are workspace files. Read returned PNGs with read_file to review their pixels; success does not approve design. Use operations to combine crop/OCR/patch/cycle steps in one call; explicit images and review_view return pixels directly to the model. Stops on first failed step; no automatic quality approval.

pack.description: review_submit: immutable review_pack report.json that supplied the review_id.

observations.description: review_submit: authored JSON containing review_id and object_reviews. Rust binds hashes without changing judgments.

previous_cycle.description: For review_pack: the bound cycle before the revision. Creates matched before/current crops and finding changes.

pages.description: Optional source page IDs for an intermediate review_pack. Omit for all pages.

page_numbers.description: For review_pack: 1-based display page numbers in this exact cycle. Use instead of pages when the user names slide numbers. Returns the authoritative page_number/page_id/render map.

ink_align.description: For fit: align visible glyph ink to the target without changing source or font size.

reflow.description: fit only: rebuild layout at target box width before aligning visible ink. Default false preserves translation-only behavior.

group.description: fit: declared typography group, one chosen exact size, and explicit targets for all members. No min/max options. An infeasible member withholds all group edits.

parts.description: split_text: ordered native text fragments with independently chosen boxes and optional style/rotation/format/region. Every canonical character, including operators, must be retained.

id.description: layout_search, split_text or represent_symbol: native text object ID within page.

group_id.description: layout_region: existing typography group constraining size_pt.

sizes_pt.description: layout_region: explicit common font-size alternatives. Returns complete candidates, never a partial group.

padding_px.description: layout_region: explicit inset from each local owner region.

basis.description: represent_symbol: why the existing raster symbol represents this canonical symbol. Requires independent pixel review; explanation is not proof.

area.description: layout_search: independently chosen local allowed area [x,y,width,height], in canvas pixels.

forbidden.description: layout_search: measured illustration/decoration rectangles or convex quads to avoid, in canvas pixels.

clearance_px.description: layout_search: required separation, frozen when registered; default 3 canvas px.

avoid_artwork.description: layout_search: conservatively avoid contrast edges in the bound background; default true. Not semantic segmentation.

register.description: layout_search: freeze object constraints for automatic actual-PPTX native QA in every later cycle/evidence_record. Does not edit deck source.

rotation.description: Explicit rigid label angle in degrees; must match the text rotation. Box is measured before rotation around its center.

targets.description: For fit with ink_align: desired visible-ink rectangles in canvas pixels, optionally rotated in their local axes. No perspective inference.

image.description: For geometry: actual blank image used to probe the proposed boundary. Quad units are source-image pixels.

max_size_pt.description: fit: explicit maximum size, can permit growth. Omitted size bounds retain current size.

max_lines.description: fit: line limit applied even without frame overflow. Explicit newlines are preserved.

inspection.description: Optional compare_cycle: current inspect report created from this bound cycle, with canvas coordinate provenance.

labels.description: Optional standalone whole-page compare label hints: id, text, box in render pixels, font_px, rotation. cycle derives these and isolated ink automatically.

background.description: Optional compare mode: blank artwork corresponding to the actual render. Produces contextual design/blank/render crops and background-subtracted signals.

tolerance.description: Pixel neighborhood tolerance for background-subtracted compare; not a quality threshold.

reason.description: Why the final delivery paths changed; task/checks/history stay unchanged.

extend_scope_reason.description: For evidence_record: explicitly add pages after the previous batch passed. Retains all prior pages, findings and attempts.

comparisons.description: For evidence_record: whole-page comparison manifest from compare_cycle for a legacy cycle.

reuse_comparisons.description: For cycle/compare_cycle: previous comparison manifest; reuse only unchanged reference/blank/render bytes.

previous_review.description: review_pack: prior bound review with previous_cycle. Rust reuses only identical local pixels and unchanged neighboring declarations.

verification_mode.description: evidence_init only. Freeze before work; default strict. Independent route retains unknown measurements and requires a different host reviewer.

reviewer_agent.description: evidence_init: exact independent reviewer session identity from peer handoff; not a nickname.

arbiter_agent.description: evidence_init with independent_visual: optional frozen third-session identity, distinct from Maker and Reviewer, allowed to adjudicate a registered fidelity false positive using current bound evidence. Cannot be added after work starts.

findings.description: finding_register: stable id, page, object_id or box, check, state open, note. Captures current pixels immediately before repairs.

topic.description: action=help: request focused evidence or review documentation without unrelated builder schemas.

steps.description: operations: ordered ordinary pptx_tool requests, stop at first failure; no nested operations.

images.description: operations: workspace image paths to attach after the steps.

groups.description: review_view: selected zero-based reading-group indexes; returns actual pixels plus measurements.

receipt.description: crop: write an immutable processing receipt.

artwork_layers.description: patch: rows {page,layers} replace the complete local raster-layer array on selected pages. Each layer has id,image,box,optional rotation,basis; painted above background and below editable text. Relative images use the source spec directory. Included in the same checked cycle.

reuse.description: crop: verified prior receipt binding; reuse only matching input bytes, algorithm and viewport. No visual verdict is reused.
